issueBody:
feat: Headless S2 — DriverHost seam and Pi-session host

## Context & motivation

Descriptor: Headless S2: introduce a DriverHost seam replacing DriverContext.pi and notifyAgent on driver paths, with a Pi-session host that preserves current behaviour and a parity test (part of epic #1018).
Type: feature

## Prior context inventory

- Part of EPIC #1018. Depends on S1 (import-surface audit). [context param]
- Decisions: DriverHost has exactly the capabilities the census found on driver paths: emit progress line, deliver terminal line (merged/handoff/aborted, keeping the handoffDeliveredAt write-ahead idempotency in work-driver-terminal-delivery.ts), lifecycle entries (lifecycle-events.ts appendEntry/registerEntryRenderer via startJob), slow-run notices (slow-notice.ts). Replace `DriverContext.pi: ExtensionAPI` (work-driver-context.ts:149) with `host: DriverHost`; route the ~12 notifyAgent/pi.sendUserMessage driver-path sites (work-driver.ts, work-entry.ts, work-driver-terminal-delivery.ts, work-driver-handoff.ts, slow-notice.ts) through it. The Pi-session host wraps ExtensionAPI with no behaviour change (still deliverAs:"steer"). All Pi references in driver modules become type-only. Plan, research and lens-review take a DriverHost (or nothing) instead of ExtensionAPI where they only forward it to dispatchCore; agents-md needs no host. [context param]
- EPIC: Headless runner for the compiled drivers [issue #1018 (OPEN)]

## Technical context

- **test-surface**: 1 reference, 8 test-surface-item, 5 edge-case; Let me investigate the existing test surface around the driver modules.; Now let me look at the key existing tests to understand what fixtures/harnesses exist.; I now have a full picture of the test surface. Let me confirm a few remaining specifics.; I have a full picture now. Let me report the structured findings.

## Acceptance criteria

- No driver-path module (work-driver*.ts, work-entry.ts, plan-driver.ts, research-driver.ts, lens-review*.ts) holds an ExtensionAPI value; only the Pi-session host module does.
- Parity test (work only): the same stubbed cycle (injected dispatchFn + forge fixture) under the Pi-session host and a recording test host produces identical pipelineState + eventLog with timestamps normalised; plan/research/lens-review are wired to DriverHost and keep their existing tests green but are not in the parity invariant.
- All existing offline smoke tests green; test-seams-wired.ts covers the new module.

## References

- extension/src/work-driver-context.ts:149 defines DriverContext.pi: ExtensionAPI (imported as type at line 15), and the seam to be replaced with DriverHost is this exact field; 26 ctx.pi read sites spread across work-driver.ts, work-driver-plan.ts, work-driver-explore-run.ts, work-driver-merged.ts, work-driver-handoff-ops.ts, work-develop-run.ts, work-develop-fence-merge.ts,…

## Test surface

- Add a NEW parity test (e.g. extension/smoke-tests/test-driver-host-parity.ts): the same stubbed /work cycle (injected dispatchFn + forge fixture, pattern from test-work-driver-skeleton.ts §3) run under (a) a Pi-session DriverHost wrapping a recording sendUserMessage and (b) a recording test DriverHost; assert identical pipelineState + eventLog with timestamps normalised. This does not exist today…
- test-work-driver-skeleton.ts is the primary work-area suite to extend: its makeFakePi() (lines ~40-48) builds an ExtensionAPI stub cast as unknown as ExtensionAPI with only sendUserMessage; ~105 test files under smoke-tests build similar fake-Pi stubs (55 in test-work-driver-*.ts alone, 134 sendUserMessage references across 88 test files), all of which need their DriverContext construction update…
- test-terminal-delivery.ts (#808) is the golden-fixture candidate for the host seam: its makeCtx(pi, issue) builds TerminalDeliveryCtx whose pi is Pick<ExtensionAPI,'sendUserMessage'>; it already pins send-first-then-handoffDeliveredAt, throw → no marker + retry delivers, and the kind=merged/handoff envelope — extend makeCtx to construct the ctx from a DriverHost instead of a raw pi object.
- test-agent-message-delivery.ts pins the deliverAs contract: notifyAgent carries deliverAs:'steer' (canary at line 50) and a tree-wide grep asserts no module calls sendUserMessage without deliverAs, exempting only agent-message.ts/async-jops.ts/types.ts. When the Pi-session host wraps ExtensionAPI it must preserve deliverAs:'steer', and the EXEMPT set / grep must be re-aimed at the host wrapper so…
- test-seams-wired.ts (the dead-code gate) must gain a Seam entry for the new DriverHost module: a canary naming a production importer (e.g. the runWorkDriver call in work-entry.ts or the DriverContext field), plus any test-only exports (e.g. a host factory) declared so an unwired export fails the gate. Its orphan check also requires the new host module to have a real production importer, not just …
- plan-driver.ts (runPlanPipeline pi at line 90) and research-driver.ts (runResearchPipeline pi at line 124) take ExtensionAPI only to forward it to dispatchCore. Their existing suites (test-plan-pipeline.ts with setPlanDispatch + FAKE_PI {registerTool:()=>{}} as never; test-research-fallback-driver.ts with setResearchDispatch + the same FAKE_PI) must keep passing when the param becomes DriverHost-…
- lens-review.ts takes an optional pi (line 201) solely to forward to the slow-run watch (work-driver-lens.ts:169 pi: ctx.pi → slow-notice). test-slow-notice-driver.ts drives the REAL driver steps (runSingleDispatch/runPlan) with fake dispatch fns and fakePi(notices) recording sendUserMessage — the slow-notice half of the DriverHost seam; keep it green and it is the natural place to assert the host…
- test-driver-envelope.ts (work-driver-handoff-message.ts renderHandoffUserMessage) and test-work-notify.ts (#388 notify hook, runWorkQueue) exercise handoff/queue message rendering independent of the host; both use their own fake pi and should stay green unchanged — they are the "no behaviour change" regression set for the Pi-session host. test-work-notify.ts in particular asserts the #388 notify …

## Edge cases & pitfalls

- The DriverHost must capture MORE than sendUserMessage: the census found driver paths also (a) call startJob(pi) in work-entry.ts (lines 177, 269) to launch driver sub-jobs, and (b) rely on lifecycle entries via lifecycle-events.ts attach(pi)/appendEntry/registerEntryRenderer. If DriverHost only exposes a notify/deliver method, the startJob(pi) and lifecycle attach(pi) call sites in work-entry.ts …
- Handoff idempotency is order-sensitive (test-terminal-delivery.ts §1 asserts handoffDeliveredAt is NOT set when sendUserMessage fires — send-first-then-record). A recording test host that captures the message synchronously must reproduce this ordering; a naive host that stamps the marker before the terminal deliver callback runs will invert the write-ahead and break the #808 re-delivery-on-resume…
- The terminal-delivery throw path (#808) throws from sendUserMessage ("Agent is already processing…") mid-send; the Pi-session host wrapping ExtensionAPI must let that rejection propagate (not swallow it) so deliverTerminalLine's traced-no-marker branch fires, and a throwing send must never become an unhandled rejection. A recording test host that never throws cannot exercise this — the parity tes…
- slow-notice.ts (line 205) falls back to getParentExtensionApi() when w.pi is absent — lens/adversarial children have no pi of their own. A DriverHost seam must not break this fallback: the host must either thread a host down to slow-notice or leave the parent-api registry path intact, or slow-run notices for lens children silently vanish. test-slow-notice-driver.ts's lens fan-out case is the guar…
- Parity invariant scope: the acceptance criterion limits parity to the WORK cycle only (plan/research/lens-review wired but not in the invariant). The parity test must normalise timestamps (eventLog `at` fields, handoffDeliveredAt ISO, any Date.now()-derived values) before comparing, and must run the cycle to a terminal state with a stubbed dispatchFn that halts before a live adversarial/lens spaw…

## Open Questions

- (none)

## Out of scope

- The headless host and CLI (S4); binary resolution (S3).


## Resolved decisions
- DriverHost covers notify/terminal delivery, lifecycle entries and slow-run notices. Dispatch keeps its own seam: dispatchCore/startJob take a narrow `DispatchHost` (the `sendUserMessage` + `appendEntry`/`registerEntryRenderer` subset startJob uses), which the Pi-session host provides; the two work-entry.ts startJob sites use it. `DriverContext.dispatchFn`'s first parameter becomes that `DispatchHost` type; tests constructing DriverContext update their stubs mechanically.
- `TerminalDeliveryCtx.pi` becomes `host: DriverHost`.
- The parity test uses an identical injected dispatchFn in both runs; it covers notify/terminal/lifecycle/slow-notice, not the spawn path (covered by existing suites).

default.scope: Replace DriverContext.pi with DriverHost seam, Pi-session host, DispatchHost for startJob, parity test
outOfScope: extension/src/dispatch-core*.ts (no changes beyond the DispatchHost type narrowing)
any headless host or CLI files (S4)
